entities.name: Q10S58
observations: Reviewed Oryza sativa protein with an exact full-length sequence match to the query: 354 aa, 100% identity and coverage, E-value 3.01e-230.
Annotated as probable serine acetyltransferase 2; catalyzes L-serine O-acetyltransferase activity in the first step of cysteine biosynthesis.
Annotated involvement in L-cysteine biosynthetic process and sulfate assimilation.
Annotated localization is cytoplasm and subunit is homomultimer.
Sequence-derived query properties: molecular weight 37,516 Da and theoretical pI 6.37.
Query Pfam domains: SATase_N at residues 80-184 and Hexapep at residues 264-297.

entities.name: L-serine O-acetyltransferase reaction
observations: Serine acetyltransferase catalyzes the first committed step toward cysteine formation by converting L-serine to O-acetyl-L-serine; the query tool directly supports the enzyme activity and pathway assignment, while the substrate-product wording is the standard biochemical interpretation of that annotation.

entities.name: L-cysteine biosynthesis
observations: Q10S58 is annotated in L-cysteine biosynthesis from L-serine and in sulfate assimilation.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: Q10S58 is annotated as a cytoplasmic protein; related Arabidopsis serine acetyltransferases are also reported in cytoplasm/cytosol, with some isoform-specific chloroplast evidence.
